summary: Diagnostic commands (render-config, validate-dynamic-config) require workarounds in containerized environments because they don't support the embedded template and --config-file flag available in the start command.
userImpact: Users must manually download template files and use workarounds to inspect and validate server configurations instead of using simple built-in diagnostic commands.
rootCause: Diagnostic commands support only legacy flag-based config loading, not the embedded template or --config-file flag that the start command supports.
proposedFix: Add support for embedded template and --config-file flag to diagnostic commands; add a command to dump the raw template; make validate-dynamic-config resolve file paths from server config automatically.
workaround: Download the embedded template from GitHub source and load via legacy flag: wget config_template_embedded.yaml && temporal-server --config /tmp render-config
keyQuote: This should be as simple as running `temporal-server render-config` with no arguments, the same way `start` works.
